new_entities.name: Endovascular therapy for acute large-vessel ischemic stroke
aliases: mechanical thrombectomy for acute LVO stroke
EVT for anterior circulation large-vessel occlusion
new_entities.description: Endovascular thrombectomy or similar endovascular reperfusion therapy used for acute ischemic stroke caused by large-vessel occlusion.

new_entities.name: Mortality and disability outcomes
aliases: functional outcome and mortality after stroke
new_entities.description: Stroke outcomes centered on mortality, severe disability, and functional independence after treatment.

edges.effect_quant: Modern randomized-trial meta-analyses consistently show that endovascular thrombectomy improves functional outcome in acute large-vessel ischemic stroke. An updated 2024 RCT meta-analysis found functional independence odds more than doubled (OR 2.19), a 2015 RCT meta-analysis found lower extreme disability or death (OR 0.77), and even among large-core strokes the 2023 living meta-analysis found an absolute 30.3% increase in functional independence.
edges.population: adults with acute ischemic stroke due to large-vessel occlusion, including standard anterior-circulation thrombectomy populations and more recently selected large-core infarct populations
edges.mechanism: Rapid mechanical reperfusion restores blood flow to salvageable brain tissue, limiting infarct growth and preventing the progression from disabling stroke to death or severe lifelong dependence.
edges.summary: This is one of the clearest interventional benefits in modern stroke care. The strongest evidence consistently supports EVT as reducing disability and improving independence across a broad range of acute LVO presentations, with mortality benefit less dramatic but overall disability outcomes clearly better.
edges.caveats: Benefits depend on time-to-treatment, occlusion site, imaging selection, and procedural expertise. Hemorrhagic complications remain important, especially in large-core patients, but the net disability benefit remains favorable in contemporary randomized evidence.

evidence.citation: Makkawi S et al 2024 Syst Rev
evidence.notes: Endovascular thrombectomy after anterior circulation large vessel ischemic stroke: an updated meta-analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: functional independence (mRS 0-2) with EVT plus medical therapy versus medical therapy alone
